name: horizon
description: Root test aggregator: farm/checks.py detects checks at the repo root only, so this script is what makes the server and ui suites run at the guardrail gate. The Python suite is wired via pytest.ini.

scripts.test: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ui run test
